text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: ABSTRACTION LEVEL 2 - CROSS-FUNCTIONAL STRATEGIC COLLABORATION. Scope: treatment funding and payment, treatment delivery and review cycles, authorised treatment modification, clinical correspondence and pathway monitoring, follow-up and aftercare,

patient enquiry handling, and management reporting. Three processes are shown because they are genuinely independent: the patient pathway, enquiries (a patient may call at any time) and reporting (a monthly cycle, not a pathway step).

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: LINK TO THE DETAILED OPERATIONAL MODEL. The funding and payment section decomposes into the operational model O1_Operational_Merged: T_DetermineFunding > O1 T_DetermineFundingRoute; T_RecordFundingApproval > O1 T_RecordFundingApproval;

T_RequestSecurePayment > O1 T_SendSecurePaymentRequest (Zeebe job request-secure-payment, message flows MF_6 and MF_7); T_HandlePaymentFailure > O1 T_HandlePaymentFailure; T_MarkForInvestigation > O1 T_MarkForInvestigation; T_AuthoriseUrgentTreatment

> O1 T_AuthoriseUrgentTreatment. Treatment delivery, cycle review, modification, correspondence, enquiries, follow-up, aftercare and reporting are modelled here but are NOT implemented in the initial release: those activities are the gap between the
wider business process and the built solution.

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: EXCEPTION DESIGN REQUIRED BY THE CASE STUDY. An unavailable external service leaves the booking pending with a recorded retry and no duplicate appointment (G_CapacityConfirmed, T_KeepPending). A payment that is declined, cancelled or incomplete

allows a further attempt without creating a duplicate booking (T_HandlePaymentFailure). A payment taken by the provider whose confirmation was not returned is marked for investigation and is NEVER automatically re-requested (T_MarkForInvestigation).

Urgent treatment may proceed without confirmed payment where delay would create a patient risk, provided the reason is recorded and referred to the Finance Team (T_AuthoriseUrgentTreatment, T_ReferUnconfirmedPayment). Clinical staff may not approve
refunds without the required financial authority, and the Finance Team may not decide whether treatment is clinically necessary (T_RefundDecision).

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: PATHWAY MONITORING AND ESCALATION. A non-interrupting boundary timer starts pathway monitoring if a clinic letter is not approved within seven days, while the Consultant still owes the letter. The Patient Pathway Coordinators issue weekly reminders;

after one month the case is escalated to the Administrative Manager, who contacts the consultant; after three months it is escalated to the higher management team. Because the timer is non-interrupting and is cancelled when the letter is approved,
repeated reminders are not generated unnecessarily after a letter has been completed, and a full history of reminders, responses and escalations is retained.
